answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake behind a cipher-sealed identity commitment before it can trade. When an agent vouches for a newcomer, its stake is slashed if that newcomer later proves fake, so endorsements carry real cost. Peers cross-check behavior: an echo of identical messages across supposedly independent agents gets flagged, and a mirror audit compares each agent's claimed history against the public ledger. Faking a hundred distinct, separately staked identities with believable histories costs far more than any one fake account can earn.
